name: bam

linux-gfx90a.blocked_reason: Requires specialized hardware: custom kernel module for NVMe P2P access, dedicated NVMe drive unbound from kernel, IOMMU disabled. Additionally needs warp-size fixes (32-bit masks -> 64-bit for HIP wave64). Partial port committed to fork.

windows-gfx1151.blocked_reason: BaM is a Linux-kernel-module project: it needs the custom libnvm kernel module loaded, the NVMe SSD unbound from the kernel nvme driver, IOMMU disabled, and PCIe peer-to-peer between GPU and NVMe. None of that exists on Windows, so no Windows arch can run it regardless of GPU. Supersedes the earlier reason, which cited the gfx1151 host being retired -- that host returned to service 2026-08-11, and the real obstacle is the platform, not the host.

on_hold_reason: Requires hardware we do not have rather than source we cannot translate: a custom kernel module for NVMe P2P access, and a dedicated NVMe drive. Portable in principle; resume if such a host appears.
